 First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute! These are the guidelines for contributing to this project.
 
+## Code of Conduct
+
+All contributors are expected to adhere to the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). 
+
+## Reporting Issues
+
+Before writing any code, please [open an issue](https://github.com/jrwnnnn/scaffold-astro/issues) or comment on an existing one. This ensures we do not have multiple people working on the same feature and allows us to discuss the approach before you invest time in building it.
+
 ## Development Setup
 
 Make sure you have the latest LTS version of [Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download/current) installed.
 
 Clone the repository:
+
 ```bash
-git clone https://github.com/jrwnnnn/scaffold.git
-cd scaffold
+git clone https://github.com/jrwnnnn/scaffold-astro.git
+cd rekord
 ```
+
 Install the required dependencies:
+
 ```bash
-npm ci
+npm install
 ```
+
 Start the development server:
+
 ```bash
-npm run dev       # optional: pass --host flag expose the server to the local network
+npm run dev       # optional: pass --host flag to expose the server to the local network
 ```
+
 Bundle the project for production:
+
 ```bash
 npm run build
 ```
-## Testing
-Before submitting a pull request, ensure everything passes locally:
 
-```bash
-# Run all unit tests
-npm run test
+## Development Guidelines
 
-# Run linting
-npx eslint .
+### Branching Strategy

-```

+- `main` contains the latest stable development code.
+- Create a new branch for each feature or bug fix. Use descriptive names like `feat/new-feature-name` or `fix/issue-description`.

+Ensure all checks pass before submitting a pull request by running:
 
-- Linting
-- Typechecking
-- Build
-- CodeQL analysis

+npm run test

+This project enforces a consistent code style using [Prettier](https://prettier.io/). A `.prettierrc` file is included in the project root to configure Prettier.
